{G : Type} →
  [inst : Group.{0} G] → [inst_1 : Fintype.{0} G] → AddMonoidHom.{1, 0} (Etingof.VirtualRepresentation G) (G → Complex)

∀ {G : Type} [inst : Group.{0} G] [inst_1 : Fintype.{0} G] (V : Etingof.VirtualRepresentation G) (g : G),
  Eq.{1} (DFunLike.coe.{2, 2, 1} Etingof.VirtualRepresentation.character V g)
    (Finset.sum.{1, 0} (Finsupp.support.{1, 0} V) fun c =>
      HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Int.cast.{0} (DFunLike.coe.{2, 2, 1} V c)) (Etingof.IrrepClasses.character.{0, 0} c g))

∀ {G : Type} [inst : Group.{0} G] [inst_1 : Fintype.{0} G] (c : Etingof.IrrepClasses.{0, 0} Complex G) (n : Int),
  Eq.{1} (DFunLike.coe.{2, 2, 1} Etingof.VirtualRepresentation.character (Finsupp.single.{1, 0} c n))
    (HSMul.hSMul.{0, 0, 0} n (Etingof.IrrepClasses.character.{0, 0} c))
